title: Prison Break
brief: Generate a storyboard for a man escaping from prison. He unlocks the door because the janitor forgot to take the keys from his cell, then steals a blaster, does a daring escape, falls while jumping over an overturned cart, shoots by accident hitting a guard. Makes it to the launch pad of the prison space colony, and steals a light cruiser.
look: Industrial sci-fi prison colony on a barren moon, worn concrete and scuffed steel, sodium and cold fluorescent light, a huge banded gas giant in the sky, shot on 35mm film, natural skin texture, muted steel-blue and orange palette.

characters.desc: a man in his mid 30s, buzzed dark hair, stubble, small scar on his chin, faded orange prison jumpsuit with a number patch
A Blonde alien hunched, grey work overalls, earbuds in, pushing a squeaky cleaning cart
prison guards in grey padded armor and dark visored helmets
a young ground-crew technician in yellow coveralls and ear protectors

notes: Example board drafted by an agent from the director's notes above. Run `storyboard frames prison_escape` to sketch every shot. Draft 1 (Claude, from the director's notes): played as action-comedy, the escape works by luck as much as skill. Four scenes: Cell block, Armory, The run, Launch pad. ~62 s, 23 shots. Callback: the janitor's key ring ends up on the cruiser's dash.
